change_summary: Changed B_block_ptr order from (1,0) to (0,1) to fix uncoalesced shared memory access (N-dim is the contiguous stride), and added 6 new autotune configs with smaller tiles (BLOCK_M=32/64, BLOCK_N=64/128, BLOCK_K=32/64) and fewer warps (num_warps=2/4, num_stages=4/5) to reduce register pressure below the 255/thread ceiling and improve warp-level latency hiding.
